headline: YEMENIS 🛥️ FLEE 🌊 Across RED SEA 🩸 as Houthis 🍆 And SAUDI-BACKED 💣 Forces ESCALATE 🏃‍♂️ WAR
text:
BBC's 📰 Frank Gardner 🗣️ is out here CHATTING 🗨️ with the poor souls 😢 who just got RAILED 💦 by the latest Houthi-Saudi escalation 🧨 in Yemen 🏜️!! Ibrahim Issa 🧔‍♂️ the 50-year-old fisherman 🎣 from coastal Dhubab right on the damn front lines ⚔️ sits surrounded by his whole family 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 on a TARPAULIN 🛠️ spread over sandy floor 🏖️ inside this massive open-sided warehouse 🏬 at Markazi camp in Obock northern Djibouti 🇩🇯 packed tighter than a can of sardines 🐟 with fellow Yemeni refugees who BOATED 🚤 across the narrow Bab al-Mandab Strait 🌊 after their terrifying sea crossing 🛥️ they trucked 🚚 and walked 🚶‍♂️ all the way here to this joint government-UN administered shelter 🏠!!

"How could I just SIT 🪑 there when my kids 👦👧 are SCREAMING 🗣️ and SHAKING 🤢 in terror from the bombs 💥" says Ibrahim Issa while his goats 🐐 nibble scraps nearby 🥬 amid discarded cooking gas canisters ⛽ and empty plastic bottles 🍼!! As a FISHERMAN 🎣 he already owned a boat big enough to load up the entire fam 👪 plus several of those very goats 🐐 that are now foraging like it's an all-you-can-eat buffet 🍽️ some families clutched tiny bundles of possessions 📦 one even dragged a tall metal shisha pipe 🚬 but others rolled up exhausted 😵‍💫 wearing literally just the clothes on their backs 👕 after more than THREE THOUSAND 3️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣ fresh refugees flooded in during the last few days alone ⏰ with the UN estimating over ONE HUNDRED TWENTY THOUSAND 1️⃣2️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️⃣ Yemenis displaced by this sudden coastal surge 🏃‍♂️!!

This month the Houthis 🚀 who already seized most populated parts of Yemen years ago made a LIGHTNING DASH ⚡ down the coast straight toward Bab al-Mandab the narrow maritime CHOKEPOINT 🛑 where southern Red Sea spills into Gulf of Aden and the big Indian Ocean 🌊!! Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦 backing the internationally recognized government fired back with HUNDREDS of air strikes ✈️💣 along the flat coastal plain where those Houthis are now digging trenches 🕳️ while the Houthis launched their own hundreds of drones 🛸 and missiles 🚀 at cities and infrastructure all over southwestern Saudi Arabia 🏙️!! Everyone in the camp keeps yelling the same thing in Arabic "We don't CARE 🙅‍♂️ which side is attacking it's the BOMBS 💥 falling ALL AROUND us that made us flee" and you can FEEL 🫀 the exhaustion dripping off every single word they spit 🗣️!!

Tiny Djibouti 🇩🇯 this former French colony sitting right across the water has zero plans of jumping into the Houthi-Saudi knife fight 🔪 yet it's one of the most militarized spots in Africa with the US running that giant Camp Lemonnier base 🏕️ since 2003 once home to the French Foreign Legion 🇫🇷 and China flexing its own massive upgraded military outpost 🏯 right on the Indian Ocean too 🌊!! Back inside Markazi camp I met Qassim Abraham Abssy the 100-year-old former fisherman 🎣 whose ID card still says he's a full century old 🕰️ and he asks rhetorically "What LED us here it was the PLANES ✈️ the sounds of the planes BOOM 💥 that's what made us run for our children's sake it burns our hearts 🔥 we don't know which side they are the Houthis are everywhere in mountains 🏔️ on roads 🛣️ and the bombs just rain down everywhere"!!

Out in the blazing 37C heat 🔥 near the neat lines of UNHCR tents ⛺ I ran into Mohammed Abdullarim from Aden a 63-year-old ex-tour guide 👳‍♂️ old enough to remember when Aden was still British protectorate territory 🇬🇧 unlike the fresh arrivals this unc has been stuck at the camp since 2015 when fighting first exploded between Houthis and the now-ousted President Abdrabbuh Mansour Hadi 👑 but suddenly while we talked the sadness of his ruined country hit him like a truck 🚚 and he turned away choking back tears 😭!! "Most people here are in the WORST condition inside those tents 🏠 I'm crying for my people 🥲 for their suffering I want our voices heard by the NGOs 🗣️ and Djibouti government and I'm thankful they accepted us" he said while the weight of it all crushed him down bad 😔!!

Yemen's been wrecked by this horrific civil war since 2014 killing tens of thousands and displacing MILLIONS 🏚️ with the shaky UN-brokered 2022 truce between Saudis and Houthis now completely cooked 💥 as both sides trade missiles 🚀 drones 🛸 and air strikes nonstop!! Sitting beside his wife on their tarpaulin amid all the camp noise Qassim the old fisherman warns he's not going back if the war keeps raging because they finally have PEACE ☮️ here in Djibouti his wife Aisha Abdulkadir Mohammed nods hard "We are willing to go back in PEACE if peace returns to our country and we are praying to God 🙏 that peace does return all we need is peace even for our children's future they get safety first then food 🍲 water 💧 and an education 📚 as you see we just fled with our clothes 👕 and left everything behind because in Yemen there is NO PEACE"!!
